newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Avgold to spend 92 mln rand on exploration.
newsitem.headline: Avgold to spend 92 mln rand on exploration.

text.p: South African gold miner Avgold Limited has approved additional spending of approximately 92 million rand for further exploration at its Target and Sun areas, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
Work will include a 3-D seismic survey, an additional 15 boreholes and 17 long deflections from existing boreholes.
The work is part of the company's project to accelerate development of its northern Free State gold projects, Avgold said.
It said drilling would start this month and completion was expected in August 1998.
